title: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research — measured pilot

ownership.note: Exact listed ministry host; rendered page identity corroborated. This is domain association evidence, not ministry endorsement of this evaluation.

conditions: Sequential Lighthouse 13.5.0 / Chrome 153 laboratory runs, three attempts per each of three predeclared pages on mobile and desktop; default simulated throttling and fresh browser processes. Operator network/geography unverified. Guarded DOM/axe observations use GET/HEAD and four-request concurrency; excluded requests can change rendering. No forms submitted, physical devices, field INP, full security audit, complete service process or 28-day reliability claim. Independent review pending. Different page samples are not a national comparison.
collectionNotes: Completion review 2026-10-26 of the 21 October follow-up: 0 previously unmeasured criteria resolved, adding 0 assessed budget points. 3/3 additional core-page follow-ups were representative; excluded captures and original attempts are retained. Prior valid timing samples are unchanged. 25 criteria remain unmeasured; see the completion record for required evidence.

Supplementary GET search tasks, where present, use observed search forms and do not expand the original Lighthouse timing sample. Retained visual comparison is explicitly distinguished from fresh capture. Collector connection failures, robots exclusions and incomplete responses are never website zeros.

Coverage revision 2026-10-28: 1 further criteria resolved using explicit reviewed evidence. Restricted, untested and monitoring-dependent criteria remain unmeasured. Scores and measurement coverage are different quantities; no conversion of missing evidence to passes or zeros.

findings.title: Reduce mobile loading cost and verify repeatability
findings.detail: The mobile homepage lab LCP median was 45.48 seconds (range 9.36–49.50 seconds, three successful runs). Median transfer was 14.33 MB. Inspect the LCP element and render-critical resources; these session measurements are not field p75 or a fixed loading time for every visitor.

findings.title: Stabilize the page layout during loading
findings.detail: Worst repeated page/device median lab CLS was 0.447, exceeding the frozen pilot zero-credit threshold of 0.25. Reserve media/widget space and inspect layout-shift traces; this is load-time lab evidence, not field CLS.

findings.title: Repair missing background images
findings.detail: Two homepage background image requests returned HTTP 404 in the browser observations and an independent HTTP follow-up. Replace their references or restore the assets.

findings.title: Remove narrow-screen horizontal overflow
findings.detail: The captured homepage document exceeded the viewport at 320, 390 and 844 CSS pixels. Check full-width sections and embedded widgets.

findings.title: Give content images and icon controls usable names
findings.detail: The homepage image inventory used empty alt attributes throughout; unnamed search/icon controls were also found. Review informative versus decorative images and accessible control names.

findings.title: Strengthen response policies and cookie configuration
findings.detail: HSTS and enforced CSP were absent in the sampled responses. Only anti-framing was present among the combined hardening checks, and the observed cookie lacked Secure, HttpOnly and explicit SameSite flags.

findings.title: Keep platform discovery in the chosen language
findings.detail: The English homepage links to a French platform directory. Provide clear language continuity, useful page descriptions and visible guidance/update context.

privacy.reason: A personal-data-policy link was present. Policy content, applicability and legal compliance were not evaluated.
Trusted HTTPS page delivery was observed; no personal-data or form submission was performed.
No complete classification of third-party requests or consent-state review was performed.
A complete purpose, retention and rights explanation for each service form was not established.
Institutional contact details were observed; a dedicated privacy-rights contact route was not independently verified.
Equivalent privacy explanations across offered languages were not reviewed.

categories.label: External Security Posture and Technical Privacy

rows.label: HTTPS enforced
rows.reason: The HTTP entry could not be evaluated because its robots policy refused collection. Successful HTTPS page loads do not establish HTTP upgrade enforcement; this row remains unmeasured.

rows.label: Valid TLS certificate
rows.reason: The three sampled HTTP captures used normal trust and hostname verification without bypassing certificate errors. One negotiated connection does not establish every enabled protocol/cipher.

rows.label: Modern TLS configuration
rows.reason: Insufficient evidence for the complete criterion: Full protocol/cipher assessment, not one negotiated connection. Untested or constrained observations are not counted as either a pass or failure.

rows.label: HSTS present and meaningful
rows.reason: Strict-Transport-Security was absent from all three successful captured ministry page responses. An HTTPS redirect is not an HSTS policy.

rows.label: Content-Security-Policy present and meaningful
rows.reason: No enforced Content-Security-Policy response header was present on the three captured pages; no CSP meta policy appeared in the rendered core observations. This is a sampled-policy finding.

rows.label: Other important security headers
rows.reason: X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN was present; nosniff and a Referrer-Policy header were absent from the captured responses, so this combined hardening row receives partial credit.

rows.label: Secure cookie configuration
rows.reason: The observed response cookie flags omitted Secure, HttpOnly and an explicit SameSite policy. Names and values are withheld. Browser default behavior is not credited as explicit cookie configuration.

rows.label: No mixed HTTP/HTTPS content
rows.reason: Insufficient evidence for the complete criterion: Browser and sampled-page evidence. Untested or constrained observations are not counted as either a pass or failure.

rows.label: No unnecessary software/version exposure
rows.reason: The Server response header identifies Apache. No deployed version was established; this is product-only exposure, not an unsupported-version finding.

rows.label: No obvious sensitive configuration exposure
rows.reason: Insufficient evidence for the complete criterion: Passive eligible-page review only; no guessed sensitive paths. Untested or constrained observations are not counted as either a pass or failure.

rows.label: Third-party tracking and technical privacy restraint
rows.reason: Insufficient evidence for the complete criterion: Request inventory plus tracking classification. Untested or constrained observations are not counted as either a pass or failure.

rows.label: Largest Contentful Paint
rows.reason: Worst median lab LCP 45481 ms. Full/half thresholds 2500/4000 ms. This is a simulated lab sample, not field p75.

rows.label: Responsiveness
rows.reason: Worst median lab TBT 2575 ms; full/half thresholds 200/600 ms. TBT is explicitly a proxy: field INP was not measured.

rows.label: Cumulative Layout Shift
rows.reason: Worst median lab CLS 0.4471; full/half thresholds 0.1/0.25. Post-load citizen flows and field CLS were not measured.

rows.label: Server response and first content
rows.reason: Worst median FCP 4524 ms; document server-response audit 1038 ms. Full limits 1800/800 ms; half 3000/1800 ms. The response audit excludes connection/redirect time.

rows.label: Resource and page-weight efficiency
rows.reason: Worst median transfer 19271435 bytes; request count 179. Full limits 2 MB/80 requests; half 4 MB/150 requests, decimal MB.

rows.label: Performance consistency
rows.reason: Largest repeated within-page/device LCP max/min ratio 5.29; full/half thresholds 1.5/2. Operator network and this session only.

rows.label: Verified WCAG 2.2 issue set
rows.reason: Repeated axe findings of unnamed links were corroborated against captured rendered anchors: icon/image-only links had no usable text alternative, aria-label or title. These serious defects in the page sample earn zero under the pilot rule. This is not a complete WCAG conformance determination.

rows.label: Color contrast
rows.reason: Carousel dates use #ec0808 on #4a90e2 (about 1.38:1 at 19px normal), and read-more text uses white on #fdc300 (about 1.62:1 at 16px bold). Independent computed-style capture corroborated both against the normal-text 4.5:1 threshold. Branding/logotype text was not used as the basis of this deduction.

rows.label: Image alternative text
rows.reason: Every homepage image in the captured desktop DOM had an empty alt attribute, including content-bearing news imagery associated with article links. Partial credit reflects missing informative equivalents; decorative images were not automatically penalized.

rows.label: Form labels, instructions and errors
rows.reason: Insufficient evidence for the complete criterion: Manual form inspection plus axe. Untested or constrained observations are not counted as either a pass or failure.

rows.label: Keyboard navigation
rows.reason: Insufficient evidence for the complete criterion: Manual keyboard path notes. Untested or constrained observations are not counted as either a pass or failure.

rows.label: Semantic HTML and headings
rows.reason: Captured pages have main headings and navigation but no main landmark, while the homepage has a very dense repeated heading outline. Partial semantic-structure credit is limited to the reviewed DOM.

rows.label: Focus indicators
rows.reason: Insufficient evidence for the complete criterion: Manual interaction notes. Untested or constrained observations are not counted as either a pass or failure.

rows.label: Correct page language and ARIA usage
rows.reason: Insufficient evidence for the complete criterion: Language and ARIA findings with manual review. Untested or constrained observations are not counted as either a pass or failure.

rows.label: Zoom, reflow and orientation
rows.reason: Insufficient evidence for the complete criterion: Manual responsive accessibility review. Untested or constrained observations are not counted as either a pass or failure.

rows.label: Complete-process accessibility check
rows.reason: No end-to-end citizen application or submission was performed. Full-process accessibility and screen-reader behavior cannot be established by the pre-submission sample.

rows.label: Uptime percentage
rows.reason: No complete 28-day, multi-network monitoring history exists for this sample. Successful point-in-time loads cannot establish uptime, failure rate or long-term continuity.

rows.label: Responsive design and reflow
rows.reason: Captured homepage width checks showed horizontal overflow at 320px (328px document), 390px (398px) and 844px (859px). Other mobile guarded loads timed out; read-only follow-up content was accessible. Localized overflow supports partial credit, not an all-page pass.

rows.label: Mobile readability and touch targets
rows.reason: Insufficient evidence for the complete criterion: Manual viewport review. Untested or constrained observations are not counted as either a pass or failure.

rows.label: Navigation and information architecture
rows.reason: Insufficient evidence for the complete criterion: Task walkthrough notes. Untested or constrained observations are not counted as either a pass or failure.

rows.label: Forms usable on mobile
rows.reason: Insufficient evidence for the complete criterion: Manual form inspection. Untested or constrained observations are not counted as either a pass or failure.

rows.label: Citizen-journey task success
rows.reason: Declared task: find the digital-platform directory and locate the diploma-authentication/grievance entry. The directory is reachable and names those platforms, but it switches from the English homepage to French. Authentication and application completion were not attempted. Partial pre-login discovery credit.

rows.label: Interface consistency
rows.reason: The sampled English homepage/research and French platform directory share a ministry header and footer, but the journey crosses languages and the homepage has horizontal overflow. Partial interface-consistency credit.

rows.label: Errors, recovery and contextual help
rows.reason: Insufficient evidence for the complete criterion: Journey and form notes. Untested or constrained observations are not counted as either a pass or failure.

rows.label: Official identity and domain ownership clear
rows.reason: The exact target host is listed as the ministry website by an independent government ministry directory; live ministry identity corroborated it. This establishes domain association, not endorsement of this research.

rows.label: Ministry mission and organization available
rows.reason: The research page names institutional/research bodies and directs readers to DGRSDT. The full ministry remit/organization was not reviewed; partial institution-information credit only.

rows.label: Public services clearly listed
rows.reason: The homepage-linked digital-platform directory lists grievance, thesis, HR, payment and diploma-authentication platforms. This is listing credit; login and service delivery were not tested.

rows.label: Procedures and eligibility explained
rows.reason: The platform directory explains its student-lifecycle purpose and names service entry points, but detailed eligibility, required documents and step-by-step application instructions were not established in this sample. Partial guidance credit.

rows.label: Required documents, forms and instructions available
rows.reason: Insufficient evidence for the complete criterion: Forms, PDFs and instructions. Untested or constrained observations are not counted as either a pass or failure.

rows.label: Service links/forms functional
rows.reason: Insufficient evidence for the complete criterion: Non-destructive manual click-through tests. Untested or constrained observations are not counted as either a pass or failure.

rows.label: Contact or feedback channel available
rows.reason: The shared ministry header supplies institutional telephone contact numbers in the reviewed pages. Calls and response quality were not tested.

rows.label: Useful multilingual content where applicable
rows.reason: Useful English research/home content and a French platform directory rendered. The English homepage digital-platform route points directly into French; equivalent service content across offered languages was not established. Partial credit for useful but incomplete language continuity.

rows.label: Publication and update dates available
rows.reason: Dated news or sector milestones were visible on the homepage, while the sampled institutional/service guidance did not consistently expose its own update date. This is partial date coverage, not a freshness or factual-accuracy certification.

rows.label: Content clarity and cross-page consistency
rows.reason: The platform directory explains its purpose and lists services, but mixes the English entry journey with French and retains a plan horizon ending December 2024 without a visible update date. This is presentation/context review, not a claim about actual programme completion.

rows.label: No significant broken internal links
rows.reason: The three declared core URLs returned HTTP 200 and their ministry content was visible in the follow-up browser review. This is a bounded three-destination check, not an exhaustive crawl or a guarantee about external service links. DOM timing failures are retained as collection gaps.

rows.label: No broken images/resources
rows.reason: Two homepage background image requests returned 404 in the original capture and again in an independent trusted HTTP follow-up. Localized broken resources prevent full credit; this is not an exhaustive asset crawl.

rows.label: Meaningful page titles and metadata
rows.reason: Rendered titles identify the ministry/research/platform pages, but the captured English homepage lacked a meta description. No all-page metadata pass is inferred from the title alone.

rows.label: Sitemap/crawlability configuration
rows.reason: The retained HTTPS sitemap response is HTTP 200 and parses as an XML sitemapindex with child entries under the ministry host. HTTPS robots policy was parsed and the declared public pages were collectable; the separate HTTP-origin robots retrieval problem is retained. This establishes sampled configuration availability, not actual search-engine indexing or completeness.

rows.label: Clean URLs, canonicalization and redirects
rows.reason: Each captured HTTPS core page supplied a canonical matching its rendered ministry path. The HTTP entry was robots-disallowed, so upgrade/canonical redirect behavior could not be established; combined URL/canonicalization credit is partial.

rows.label: Functional site search and discoverability
rows.reason: Insufficient evidence for the complete criterion: Manual search task, not mere input presence. Untested or constrained observations are not counted as either a pass or failure.

rows.label: No critically outdated public technology
rows.reason: No deployed version plus primary-vendor support status was established. A product-family fingerprint alone cannot justify an obsolete-technology score.

rows.label: Cross-page technical consistency
rows.reason: The declared core pages returned HTML with consistent ministry navigation and page identity in the reviewed renderings. This sample-bounded credit does not certify every page or browser; individual defects remain recorded separately.
